messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — CI flagged an AUTH_BYPASS in generated protobuf adapters in service-auth (PR #1234). looks like noise but wanted to surface.
Ashok Varma: Can you paste the exact SAST finding id? sometimes the rule trips on generated switch/if fallthroughs.
Maya Patel: finding: SAST-HTTP-0129 from the vendor scanner. snippet: ```
if (!err) { return resp } // linter thinks missing auth check
// this file is generated by protoc-gen-typed-auth, do not edit
```
Olivia Chen: @Maya can you link the PR and the build log? also which scanner version? we had an update last week that changed heuristics.
Maya Patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service-auth/pull/1234
CI log: https://ci.redwood/4567/logs
Scanner: sast-cli v3.2.1
scan-bot: scan-bot posted a new report: https://scans.redwood/reports/7890 (SAST-HTTP-0129) :rotating_light:
Kevin (SRE): Quick note — if this is truly generated code, we should suppress at file-level with an exempt marker and add the generator to the exemption whitelist. But audit needs evidence of review.
Security Triager: Agree. Steps I'd take: 1) confirm generated tag in header, 2) verify generator version, 3) confirm no auth logic lives in handwritten wrappers, 4) create suppression with justification + reviewer.
Ashok Varma: I pulled the generated file. Header includes: "// Code generated by protoc-gen-typed-auth v0.9.3; DO NOT EDIT." That generator recently had a patch for early-return patterns.
Olivia Chen: Does the generator include a shared auth util that's imported? If so, the fix should be there not in every repo.
Maya Patel: generator calls auth.CheckedResp(...) from internal/authpkg which is handwritten in this repo. the SAST rule flags the generated if guard before the util call.
Security Triager: For the audit trail: we need the PR diff, the generator version, and a short note from the service owner confirming the util has auth checks. Add that to the suppression ticket.
Maya Patel: created ticket: https://issues.redwood/SC-2024 with the evidence (PR + generator sha + tests). tagging @Olivia for review.
Olivia Chen: I'll review. If it's confirmed FP, we can: a) add an inline suppression with comment and link to SC-2024, b) add generator to global whitelist, and c) add a unit test to assert auth util invocation to prevent regression.
Kevin (SRE): One more ops consideration — the scanner SA currently needs read access to the monorepo. If we add file-level suppressions we should ensure scanner logs the suppression event to audit-logs.svc (so we can show who approved).
Ashok Varma: How do we capture that? we have an audit webhook for policy changes but not for SAST suppressions.
Security Triager: We can hook the suppression workflow to the policy service: when a suppression is created it should POST to /audit/suppressions with: repo, file, rule, justification, approver. For short-term, attach the approval comment in the ticket and mark as triaged.
Maya Patel: Will do short-term triage today. If @Olivia approves, I'll add inline //sast: deny=false SC-2024 and push.
Olivia Chen: Reviewing now — estimated 30m. If approved, let's also add a follow-up to get generator owners to ship the pattern fix (so rule isn't noisy).
scan-bot: suppression-request created by Maya Patel: https://scans.redwood/suppressions/555 (status: pending review)
Kevin (SRE): FYI for future incidents: ephemeral RBAC we gave to scanner service-account last quarter had an audit gap; make sure the suppression flow emits an explicit grant footprint (service-account, ttl, approver). I can add a small middleware in policy-service to log that.
Ashok Varma: marking as non-blocking for the deploy once triaged -- CI gate will remain soft-fail until we close SC-2024.
Maya Patel: thanks all — will update the ticket when suppression pushed. :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: thanks, Maya. If anything unexpected pops up in the generator test, ping infra and sec oncall.
Security Triager: Closing loop: once suppression is in and ticket has audit evidence + generator follow-up spelled out, we can close as FP with remediation plan.
Maya Patel: update: suppression added in PR, comment linked to SC-2024, Olivia approved. leaving notes for generator owners.
